conspecific.definition:
n. an organism belonging to the same species as another organism
a. belonging to the same species

conspecifics.definition:
plural of conspecific
n. an organism belonging to the same species as another organism
a. belonging to the same species
conspecifics.translation: (conspecific 的复数) a. 同种的

conspectus.translation: n. 概观, 一览表, 大纲

conspicuity.definition:
n. The state or quality of being clear or bright;
   brightness; conspicuousness.

conspicuous.definition: a. obvious to the eye or mind
conspicuous.translation: a. 显著的, 显眼的, 出众的

conspicuous consumption.translation: n. 炫耀性消费, 挥霍; 摆阔性消费

conspicuously.definition: r. in a manner tending to attract attention
conspicuously.translation: adv. 显著地, 超群地

conspicuousness.definition:
n. the state of being conspicuous
n. high visibility

conspiracies.translation: n. 阴谋, 密谋( conspiracy的名词复数 )

conspiracy.definition:
n. a secret agreement between two or more people to perform an unlawful act
n. a plot to carry out some harmful or illegal act (especially a political plot)
n. a group of conspirators banded together to achieve some harmful or illegal purpose
conspiracy.translation:
n. 同谋, 阴谋, 阴谋集团
[法] 阴谋, 通谋, 共谋

conspiration.definition:
n. Agreement or concurrence for some end or purpose;
   conspiracy.
conspiration.translation: n. 合作, 协力; [废语]共谋, 阴谋, 密谋

conspirative.definition: a relating to or characteristic of conspiracy or conspirators

conspirator.definition: n. a member of a conspiracy
conspirator.translation:
n. 同谋者, 阴谋者, 反叛者
[法] 共谋者, 阴谋家

conspiratorial.definition: a. relating to or characteristic of conspiracy or conspirators
conspiratorial.translation:
a. 阴谋的, 阴谋者的
[法] 阴谋的, 共谋的

conspirators.definition: n. a member of a conspiracy
conspirators.translation: n. 共谋者, 阴谋家( conspirator的复数形式 )

conspiratress.translation: n. 女性共谋者(阴谋者, 谋叛者)

conspire.definition:
v. engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together
v. act in unison or agreement and in secret towards a deceitful or illegal purpose
conspire.translation:
vi. 阴谋, 协力, 共谋
vt. 图谋

conspired.translation: v. 密谋( conspire的过去式和过去分词 ); 搞阴谋; （事件等）巧合; 共同导致

conspirer.definition: n. One who conspires; a conspirator.

conspires.definition:
v engage in plotting or enter into a conspiracy, swear together
v act in unison or agreement and in secret towards a deceitful or illegal purpose
conspires.translation: v. 密谋( conspire的第三人称单数 ); 搞阴谋; （事件等）巧合; 共同导致

conspiring.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Conspire
conspiring.translation: v. 密谋( conspire的现在分词 ); 搞阴谋; （事件等）巧合; 共同导致

conspiringly.definition: adv. In the manner of a conspirator; by conspiracy.

conspirito.translation: [意][音]热烈地； 激昂地, 精神饱满地

conspue.translation: vt. 公然抨击, 唾弃

conspurcate.definition: v. t. To pollute; to defile.
conspurcate.translation: [医]具乱点的, 使脏的, 染污的
